meals.assumptions: Assumes the entire plate was eaten, standard entree portions, and half of each listed side portion. User confirms eating the fortune cookie (20 kcal, 5 g carbs per published standard cookie). Receipt order time is not necessarily eating time. Portion variation is represented by approximate ranges. suggestions.detail: Replacing the Orange Chicken with a standard serving of grilled teriyaki chicken would reduce the published meal total by about 280 kcal while adding about 19 g protein. Keep the half-greens side if you enjoy it.

nextMove.topic: Keep a steady pulse while learning syncopation.
nextMove.why: The Entertainer is a ragtime piece. Understanding how the melody can fall between beats gives you a useful foundation before combining it with the accompaniment. Your arrangement is still unknown, so this is a general first step.
nextMove.learn: First check that you can count the beats and subdivide them evenly. Then study syncopation: rhythmic emphasis shifts toward a weak beat or weak part of a beat, sometimes through a note tied across a stronger beat. The accompaniment can keep the steady pulse underneath.
nextMove.exercise: Choose two to four bars from your own score. Tap a steady beat with one hand and clap the melody’s rhythm with the other while counting subdivisions aloud. Then try the melody alone at a comfortable slow tempo. Log which rhythm is confusing before adding the accompaniment.
nextMove.success: Self-check: repeat the passage’s rhythm three times without losing the steady tapped pulse. Point to one place where emphasis falls on a weak part of a beat or a note carries across a stronger beat. Report what happened; this is not yet a verified result.
